defects_found.description: Round 2 classified 8 rule-families by INSTRUMENT FAMILY (surface form — e.g. 'is this an ATM bilateral?', 'is this a ship-classification-society accreditation?') rather than by MECHANISM (does the instrument price/cap/standard/verify/enable freight's carbon or environmental intensity?). 85 rows classified off_vertical under those 8 rules (ses_performance_plan_administration 25, denylist_atm_air_services_bilateral 17, ship_classification_society_accreditation 9, ses_route_charging_zone_administration 9, port_state_control_administration 8, rail_freight_corridor_governance 7, transit_ecopoints_bilateral_agreement 6, heavy_goods_vehicle_charging_administration 4) were determined by round 3's mechanism-test re-audit to actually satisfy an on-vertical mechanism prong.
defects_found.root_cause: round 2's rule set (screen-rules.mjs as of commit 4f29b053) pattern-matched on document/instrument family rather than on the freight-carbon/environmental mechanism the vertical is actually defined by; the mechanism test itself (Wave M-screen-3) did not exist yet.
defects_found.fix_ref: fsi-app/scripts/mint/screen-rules.mjs — the 8 rules' verdict fields flipped to on_vertical (6 tagged '// FLIP (operator ruling 2026-08-31)', 2 tagged '// FLIP (mechanism re-audit 2026-08-31 ...)'), landed in commit 6227e41f. See screen-run-003.json.

proposer_notes: Round 2 is a two-stage run: census-would-mint.screen-results.json/.screen-summary.md is the rule-engine-ONLY output (970/945/1746, self-reported 'Generated: 2026-08-31T18:10:43.663Z' — used here as started_at), then census-final.screen-results.json/.screen-summary.md is the SAME run after the --reviewed merge (1630/1775/256, 'Generated: 2026-08-31T18:40:32.385Z'). Both are one harness run in this artifact's terms (one screen-worklist.mjs invocation chain against one input), not two. per_item is deliberately empty: at 3,661-row scale, CONVENTION.md's 'per_item at scale' rule keeps row-level truth in full_trace_refs (both results JSON files hold every row) rather than inlining a lossy restatement; no report table in this round names individual rows the way BATCH-001-REPORT-v2.md does for mint. harness_version hashes commit 4f29b053's screen-rules.mjs/screen-worklist.mjs (checked out via git show into a scratch dir, not the current HEAD, which is round 3's state) — reproducible from git history alone. defects_found and metrics.operator_overturn_rate were computed this session by a row-by-row diff (by census_worklist id) of census-final.screen-results.json against census-final-v3.screen-results.json: 99 rows changed verdict, all off_vertical->on_vertical, none to/from ambiguous (256 is identical in both files) — 85 where both the before and after row carry provenance='rule' (attributed to the 8 flipped rules by their post-flip rule name), 14 where both carry provenance='reviewed'. This is real, reproducible arithmetic over the two committed results files, not a paraphrase of the task dispatch's own summary language.
